content.title: About
content.content: The club sandwich on white bread is a classic multi‑layered sandwich made with toasted white bread, chicken breast, ham, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise. It is a staple in cafés and restaurants worldwide and is usually served cut into triangles.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first club sandwich appeared in the early 1920s at New York’s Buck’s Club.
Traditionally it consists of three slices of bread and four fillings, creating the characteristic “tower” look.
The original recipe used only turkey, but most modern versions add chicken and ham.
The sandwich is often held together with a toothpick for stability.
In the United States the club sandwich is considered comfort food and frequently appears on brunch menus.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Chicken, ham and bacon provide a high amount of protein needed for tissue repair.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: The meat components contain niacin, vitamin B6 and B12, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains vegetables
items.content: Tomato and lettuce add vitamin C, potassium and antioxidants.

items.title: Quick energy
items.content: The sandwich delivers a fast supply of calories, making it a satisfying snack.

items.title: Calcium from cheese (optional)
items.content: Adding a slice of cheese increases calcium content, beneficial for bones.

items.title: High in fat and sodium
items.content: Bacon and ham can be high in saturated fat and salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Egg and dairy allergy
items.content: Mayonnaise is typically made with eggs and oil, posing a risk for allergic individuals.

items.title: Foodborne illness risk
items.content: Undercooked bacon or chicken can harbor salmonella or campylobacter.

items.title: Calorie dense
items.content: A three‑layer club easily exceeds 600 kcal, so portion control is advisable.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is usually served cut into three triangles and held together with a toothpick. It can be eaten with the hands, though a knife and fork are also acceptable.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Club sandwiches are best eaten immediately. If needed, store in the refrigerator wrapped in plastic wrap for no more than 24 hours. Bread may become soggy and mayonnaise may separate.
